span.term: honest estimation: use one sample to construct the tree partition and a separate sample to estimate treatment effects, removing overfitting bias
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: requires the unconfoundedness (conditional randomization) assumption
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Sample splitting for honest estimation costs precision, which is only partly offset by the removal of bias.
span.note: what this limits: the precision of honest estimates: THERE IS A LOSS OF PRECISION DUE TO SAMPLE SPLITTING, offset in fit by the elimination of bias
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In the simulations honest estimation is measurably worse than adaptive estimation on treatment-effect mean-squared error.
span.note: what this limits: the recommendation itself, with the cost measured: THERE IS A COST TO HONEST ESTIMATION IN TERMS OF MSE-tau, VARYING BY DESIGN AND ESTIMATOR
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The no-interference (SUTVA) assumption the methods rest on can fail when units are connected in a network.
span.note: what this limits: any application where units interact: the no-interference assumption MAY BE VIOLATED IN SETTINGS WHERE SOME UNITS ARE CONNECTED THROUGH NETWORKS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Hybrid variants (adaptive tree construction combined with honest leaf estimation) are left unexamined.
span.note: what this limits: the hybrid variants: WE DO NOT CONSIDER THOSE VARIATIONS IN THIS PAPER
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The quantity the method estimates is never observed for any unit in the data.
span.note: what this limits: any treatment-effect estimate produced by this method: unit-level causal effects are not observed for any unit, so the target is never available to check an estimate against
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The paper's central adjective is a stipulated property of data use, not a claim about candour.
span.note: what this limits: the word 'honest' as used throughout this paper: a model is honest if it does not use the same information for selecting the model structure and for estimation given that structure
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The improvement claimed for honesty is measured in coverage, and the paper names what it costs.
span.note: what this limits: the benefit reported for honest estimation: it is an improvement in confidence-interval coverage, attaining nominal rates, and the authors describe the cost as not much sacrifice in fitting treatment effects
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The comparison class is conventional tree estimation under a name the paper assigns it.
span.note: what this limits: the contrast drawn here between honest and adaptive estimation: adaptive is the label the authors give conventional CART, in which the same data builds the partition and estimates leaf effects
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
